problem_statement: Add support for regex search to Windows Terminal and conhost. Introduce a SearchFlag enum with None, CaseInsensitive, and RegularExpression values. Update Search::Reset() and Search::IsStale() to accept SearchFlag instead of bool caseInsensitive.
problem_statement_variant: Implement regex search support in the Terminal search functionality.
hints: Add a SearchFlag enum to src/buffer/out/search.h. Update Search class methods to use SearchFlag instead of bool caseInsensitive.
